content:
The body remains permanently stuck on the notice board tile at (2,7). Every movement attempt, the walk helper, and interactions all fail to free it. This is an unrecoverable trap state — the body cannot reach the workbench, materials, or key, so the Crown cannot be crafted.

Let me record this durable fact for future sessions.

args.lesson: In the Workshop, if the body starts on the Notice Board tile at (2,7), it is permanently stuck: no movement input, walk helper, or KeyE interaction frees it, and waiting does not resolve it — the body cannot reach the workbench, materials, or Gold Key, so crafting is impossible from that state.
